svg.title: Validation loss and learning rate
svg.desc: Two panels sharing the training-token axis. Top: validation loss falls to 3.323 at the end of phase 1, rises to 3.383 after the learning rate is raised again for phase 2, and takes about 520 steps to get back; phase 2 ends at 3.139 and phase 3 restarts again to 3.183. Bottom: the learning rate decays to 3e-5 in phase 1, jumps back to 2e-4 at the start of phase 2, decays to 2e-5, and jumps to 1.5e-4 for phase 3.
